name: Cardeñuela Riopico (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cardeñuela Riopico (a castle and a crozier).
history: Municipal flag of Cardeñuela Riopico; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cardeñuela Riopico arms — castle and crozier
